viewer.bye.error: The remote view ended because of an error.

viewer.noAudio: Sound does not work in this browser.
viewer.noDownloads: The app has not downloaded anything yet.

viewer.settings.audioHint: You set the volume in the app's window.
viewer.settings.gpuHint: Rendering and encoding on the GPU; without a GPU the processor does the work.
viewer.settings.imageMissing: Not loaded yet – comes automatically with the first remote view.

viewer.settings.noViews: No remote view is open right now.
viewer.settings.profilesHint: A browser profile of its own per account and app, so logins in the apps are kept (.titanos/viewer).
viewer.settings.qualityHint: Automatic adapts frame rate and bit rate to the connection.
viewer.settings.title: Remote view
viewer.settings.transportHint: Tiles send only what changes and redraw text losslessly after scrolling. When a large part of the picture moves for more than 5 seconds the view switches to video, and back after 3 calm seconds. Each app's window can change it.
viewer.settings.viewsNow: {open} open now, room for about {room} more (avg. {per} per view)
viewer.settings.viewsNowShort: {open} open now, room for about {room} more
viewer.transport.autoHint: Sharp text, almost no data when idle
viewer.transport.videoHint: As up to 0.67, steady data rate
viewer.unsupported.text: The remote view needs WebCodecs. Chrome, Edge, Opera and Brave from version 94, Safari from 16.4 (also iPhone and iPad) and Firefox from version 130 have it.

viewer.uploadError.no_space: no room left (profile full or volume nearly full)
